notes.title: The Remakening is here!
notes.notes: [p][i]The year has passed, and it's time to show you what I've been working on! Get ready for a wild ride: The Remakening is a free update that will DOUBLE existing content of Isekaing![/i] [i]Enjoy... or suffer. I don't care.[/i][/p][previewyoutube="nm9Axrshpq8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]New story arc:[/b]  [/p][p]The Remakening is upon us! [/p][p]Welcome to the Unhollywood, the land where dreams became real, but now a dark shadow looms over the once peaceful kingdom. And it's full of shit! Visit classic fairytales twisted by the constant cash-grab remakes of the MOUSE corporation and its undead ruler, and do your worst to fix them, or... just survive. [/p][p]Dozens of new levels, mechanics, fully voiced characters, and, most importantly - a truckload more of the unhinged satire and parody! Just remember - dying from laughter is not a valid reason to sue the dev.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Combat system:[/b]   [/p][p]The time for action has come! The real-time combat system arrived - burn, smite, and shoot your enemies. Not too much of them, since it is still an adventure game, but all things are good in moderation! Except for the retarded jokes. [/p][p][/p][p][b]New songs:[/b]   [/p][p]Since this is also a musical, the characters will keep singing to you, and the quality of songs has increased! You can still skip them if you want to - but you will be missing a lot of fun. [/p][p][/p][p][b]New puzzles and challenges:[/b]   [/p][p]If you need to put your restless mind to work. But they are also skippable for those who don't like them. [/p][p][/p][p]Also - there are numerous bug fixes, improved VA, extra scenes and major optimization improvements. [/p][p][/p][p][i]The update is 100% free, no price increase, no extra packages or other bs. If you own the base game - you already have it (it starts after you leave the Party).[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][b]Players who already own the game are advised to delete all existing files of the game and install it anew instead of updating and delete all previous saves to avoid having possible bugs.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Have fun! [/p]

notes.title: The Eternal Silence update
notes.notes: You asked for it! Well, actually just two persons asked for it, but i delivered anyway, and now almost all songs in the game can be skipped by holding cancel button (there are in-game tip for that). Big thanks for AquaEcho for explaining me how to code this function.

notes.title: The big spelling update is now live!
notes.notes:
Over 300 dialogue lines were fixed, and no thralls were hurt in the process! Some of the most slippery typos could have avoided the purge, but they will be found and eliminated later. 

Added new room with control schemes for PC, Steam Deck and Xbox controller at the start of the game. 

Few new jokes found their way into the game, and some of the old ones were polished better.

notes.title: Regarding spelling errors and bad english in general.
notes.notes: I am sorry if it caused problems for you. I knew my english is bad, but didn't knew that it's THAT bad. Fixing it is my top priority now. I don't know how long it will take because i either will need help of native speaker, or a lot of time to find new automated checking systems (since those i used before failed me). Also i will have to record new VA lines. But it will be done.

notes.title: Isekaing is Steam Deck compatible!
notes.notes:
No need to do anything on your side, just launch it from the SD and play! 

The default control scheme: 

D-Pad and Left Analog stick is for movment. 
A button to interact or confirm. 
B is to go back (but not in time). 
Y is for opening the menu. 

This hint also can be found in-game, so no need to leave this page open. 

Unfortunatly, Valve does not allow developers to manually start reviewing process for Deck, and I need to wait until they will select my game for review. But everything is already done, so game is playable on Steam Deck! Just launch it and enjoy. 

Have fun!

notes.notes:

2. Increased the sub-optimal amount and variety of fucks in Zoe's vocabulary. 

3. Replaced deceased hamsters from game's engine, it should run at full speed now. 

4. Forgot what it was about, but it was also a positive change.
